# Desktop menu catalog

<!-- Generated by docs/tools/docs_check.py --write from menu-catalog.jsonl. Edit the JSONL, not this file. -->

One entry per desktop menu (the 198 named `MENU_DATA` items in 13 ribbon tabs): the desktop form it opens, what it does for the business, how the screen looks, the tables it writes (reads, for reports), where the web implements it, what the web screen can do today, what is still missing and which plan items own the remainder. Desktop behaviour is described from the decompiled source, the official tutorial videos (`project-memory/video-research/_kb`) and the form catalogs; the web columns were read from the code at the date of the last edit.

Statuses are this catalog's own engineering grade, not acceptance: no menu is accepted until it passes the desktop comparison and business sign-off in [document 04](../master-parity-plan-2026-09-29/04-verification-playbook.md).

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| FULL | Every desktop mode, lifecycle action and print exists on the web; only acceptance remains |
| PARTIAL | A working web workflow exists but desktop modes, lifecycle actions, fields or prints are missing |
| REPORT | Report data is shown, but desktop modes, filters, drill-downs or the print layout are incomplete |
| CONTAINED | The web refuses the operation on purpose until it is safe (see the containment registry) |
| MISSING | No equivalent web workflow exists |

Capabilities: C create, R reopen a saved voucher, E edit it, D delete it, P print/document, L list saved vouchers (for reports: L shows rows, P prints or exports). Phases: **P1-core** is needed for desktop parity in a typical jewellery business; **P1-edition** only for specific editions or settings; **defer** has no desktop workflow.

### Account Group

- **Desktop:** `MS_AC_GROUP` — direct constructor ([MDI_FORM.cs:7481-7490](../../unified/src/csharp/DataCareNext/MDI_FORM.cs#L7481-L7490)).
- **Does:** Maintains the account-group hierarchy and book-account mappings that classify parties and drive posting and final statements.
- **Looks:** Search grid beside group code, name and main-group fields; standard Print/Save/Cancel/Delete/Exit bar.
- **Writes:** AC_GROUP, BOOK_IDTL.
- **Web:** `/masters/ac-groups`; `GET /masters/:name`, `POST /masters/:name`, `PUT /masters/:name`, `DELETE /masters/:name`. Can: create, reopen, edit, delete, list.
- **Remaining:** Generic CRUD only; desktop conditional fields, reference guards, Print, F1 help and keyboard order are unproven against the desktop.
- **Owners:** X10, N60, G62, N77.
- **Evidence:** [KB_master.md:134-145](../../project-memory/video-research/_kb/KB_master.md#L134-L145).

### Admin Setting

- **Desktop:** `UT_SET_ADMIN` — direct constructor; non-admin users are refused ([MDI_FORM.cs:7521-7535](../../unified/src/csharp/DataCareNext/MDI_FORM.cs#L7521-L7535)).
- **Does:** Controls privileged company policies kept outside the ordinary operator settings.
- **Looks:** Dense settings controls with the standard action bar; the web shows it as a tab of Settings.
- **Writes:** CO_SET_NEW.
- **Web:** `/settings`; `GET /settings`, `POST /settings`. Can: reopen, edit, list.
- **Remaining:** Not proven equivalent to the privileged form: action-level authorisation, every consumer effect, Print and layout remain.
- **Owners:** X08, X29, G62, N77.
- **Evidence:** [UT_SET_ADMIN.initcomp.json](../../web/apps/api/form-specs/UT_SET_ADMIN.initcomp.json).
